name: manual_3fe9eb
claim: For the periscope repo, ALWAYS run Go tests with 'CGO_ENABLED=1 go test -tags fts5 ./...' (per the repo's own Makefile and .github/workflows/ci.yml -- every real invocation uses -tags fts5, several add more tags like pgtest/s3test/evalingest for specific suites). Never run plain 'go test ./...' there -- it silently disables the FTS5 sqlite module (mattn/go-sqlite3 needs the build tag to compile in fts5 support), producing spurious 'no such table: messages_fts' / phase-message-ordering failures that look like real bugs but are just a missing build tag.

decisions.notes: 2026-08-03: spent much of a session concluding internal/sync and scripts package test failures (and later TestDoSyncConfiguredFullUnifiedHTTPUsesManifestDeltaAndOrderedProgress) were a 'pre-existing FTS5 test-environment condition,' confirmed identical on pristine kenn-io/agentsview upstream and pristine periscope merged -- true in the sense that ALL THREE trees fail the same way without the tag, but false in the sense that it isn't a real environment limitation at all: it's just that I never passed -tags fts5. Re-running the exact same failing test with the correct tag passed immediately. The repo's own CI/Makefile use the tag on every invocation, so this was fully avoidable by checking those first instead of assuming plain 'go test' was the intended invocation.
